description: KnowFlow is an open-source software tool listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Water", published or maintained by KnowFlow (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). The list files it under "Water" (water resources). The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open.
